text: {"answer": "In L4 (ChromaDB vector embeddings), sub-KB documents are stored under the parent KB's collection — `vector_index.collection` always points at the parent KB collection. Consequently, searching the sub-KB's own UUID returns 0 results; you must search the parent KB instead. Each KB maps to one collection named `kb_{kb_id}`, with each document split into N chunks named `{doc_path}__chunk_{index}`.", "evidence_used": ["ARCHITECTURE"]}
